children: StonkBrokers developer Clutch Markets said the platform will launch its decentralized market-making feature, Smart LP, on September 8. According to Foresight News, users will be able to deposit assets on one side or both sides and choose a strategy, with Smart LP using the assets to provide liquidity for Uniswap stock token trading pairs.

The related rewards will also support single-sided staking for stock tokens. Holders of StonkBroker NFTs will be able to use ERC-6551 wallets to put stock tokens held in their Broker accounts to work and earn yields.

title: StonkBrokers to Launch Decentralized Market-Making Feature Smart LP on September 8
